description: This Java source file defines the UtilCacheEvents class, which contains static methods for handling web requests related to cache operations such as removing, clearing, updating, and managing cache entries in the OFBiz webtools framework.

classes.name: UtilCacheEvents
classes.description: Helper class containing static methods to handle cache management events via HTTP requests.

methods.name: removeElementEvent
methods.description: Removes a specific element from a named cache based on request parameters, with permission checks.

methods.name: clearEvent
methods.description: Clears a specified cache if permissions are granted.

methods.name: clearAllEvent
methods.description: Clears all caches, assuming the user has proper permissions.

methods.name: clearSelectedCachesEvent
methods.description: Clears multiple selected caches based on user input, with permission checks.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates configuration of a named cache such as max entries, expiration, and soft reference usage, if permitted.
